## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Documentation or repository tooling update

## Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with zero TypeScript errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes (unit tests updated if gameplay/scoring logic changed)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly
- [ ] Works cleanly with **no `.env` secrets** configured (procedural beatmap & Keyboard Arcade fallback verified)
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, or personal data committed
